🗺️ Trial and error

Exploration vs. exploitation

In simple words

The choice an agent faces between trying something new (exploring) and using what already works (exploiting).

The choice every learning agent faces: try something new to find out whether it's better (exploration), or use what has worked best so far (exploitation). Only exploiting can miss the best option; only exploring wastes time. A simple rule is to explore now and then, for example 1 time in 10, and exploit the rest of the time.

Example. At your favourite café, do you order your usual (exploit) or try something new on the menu (explore)? If you never try anything new, you'll never find out there's something you'd like even more.

Related words

  • AgentAn AI that acts on its own to reach a goal: it notices what is happening, chooses an action and sees the result.
  • Q-learningA reinforcement learning method in which an agent learns a score (a Q-value) for every action in every situation.
  • RewardThe score an agent gets after an action, telling it how good the result was.
